in_marathi.name: Anaviya
in_marathi.long_meaning: Anaviya हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The graceful one who is a part of creation, nourished by the five elements. This name is derived from the Sanskrit words ‘anu’ meaning near or with, and ‘viya’ meaning elements.

in_bengali.name: Anaviya
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Graceful One
in_bengali.long_meaning: Anaviya একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। The graceful one who is a part of creation, nourished by the five elements. This name is derived from the Sanskrit words ‘anu’ meaning near or with, and ‘viya’ meaning elements.
